name: Love Yourself
overview: Scripture teaches that loving yourself is foundational to loving others, as seen in Leviticus 19:18 and Romans 13:9 where the command to love your neighbor is linked directly to loving yourself. This self-love is not selfish but rooted in understanding God's design for relationships, with Jesus emphasizing the greatest commandment to love God fully in Matthew 22:37. Encouragement to act courageously and faithfully in personal responsibility, as in Ezra 10:4, further supports living out this love in obedience to the Lord.
